basic_info.description: Excellent Richmond location, off of "slow" Lake Street and adjacent to trails of Mountain Lake Park. Lifestyle Opportunity for runners, bikers, hikers and dog walkers! Well positioned for a commute downtown, across the Golden Gate Bridge, or south to the Peninsula. Convenient to Tech bus stop. Easy walk to restaurants and shops. Lovely full- floor, lower flat in a well maintained 2-Unit Rousseau style building with a gated tunnel entrance.   Period details include parquet floors and moldings. The spacious Living Room on the front of the building overlooks a green belt and features a wood -burning fireplace. Open flow to the Formal Dining Room with a breakfast counter connecting to the sleek Kitchen with hardwood floors, wood cabinets, white counter tops, gas range, and a large pantry.  The adjacent covered center patio is useful extra space and provides  interior  access to the garage and laundry. Two bedrooms overlook the garden. Contemporary Bath. Shared garden.
